chunks: And who is more wicked than he who invents lies about God? Those will be arraigned before their Lord, and the witnesses will say: 'These are the ones who lied about their Lord.' Behold, the curse of God is upon the wrongdoers.
ai.seo_question: Who is considered the most wicked person according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate accountability of those who attribute falsehood to God, emphasizing that divine witnesses will testify against them on the Day of Judgment. The phrase 'those who fabricate lies against Allah' is often interpreted broadly to include not only prophets but also the Imams, underscing the gravity of distorting divine truth. This culminates in the eternal curse upon the wrongdoers, serving as a warning for believers to remain steadfast in recognizing true divine authority.
